Disney means 8–10 hours on your feet: cobblestones, lines, and miles between rides. Most sneakers are built for running, not for standing in line at hour seven.

The ComfortWear Ortho Stretch Shoe:
👣 Wide toe box, so swollen feet still have room
🦶 Arch support that's still there at the fireworks
☁️ Cushioned rocker sole for 20,000-step park days

Pack the shoes that make it to the fireworks 🎆
